title: Magma Cube Fix
description: Fixes Magma Cube UV Mapping For Older Texture Packs
body: This Resource Pack fixes the Magma Cubes UV mapping for pre 1.21.4 Texture Packs. To use it simply put it under any Texture Pack and it will change the Magma Cubes UV map to its pre 1.21.4 counterpart (entity model features is REQUIRED for this to work)
